==========================================
__has_include with angle brackets
==========================================

#if __has_include(<endian.h>)
int a;
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (preproc_if
    (call_expression
      (identifier)
      (argument_list
        (system_lib_string)))
    (declaration
      (primitive_type)
      (identifier))))

==========================================
__has_include with quotes
==========================================

#if __has_include("missing.h") || __has_cpp_attribute(nodiscard) >= 201603
int c;
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (preproc_if
    (binary_expression
      (call_expression
        (identifier)
        (argument_list
          (string_literal
            (string_content))))
      (binary_expression
        (call_expression
          (identifier)
          (argument_list
            (identifier)))
        (number_literal)))
    (declaration
      (primitive_type)
      (identifier))))

==========================================
__has_attribute with an identifier
==========================================

#if __has_attribute(noreturn)
int b;
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (preproc_if
    (call_expression
      (identifier)
      (argument_list
        (identifier)))
    (declaration
      (primitive_type)
      (identifier))))

==========================================
__has_cpp_attribute with a scoped name
==========================================

#if __has_cpp_attribute(clang::fallthrough)
int d;
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (preproc_if
    (call_expression
      (identifier)
      (argument_list
        (qualified_identifier
          (namespace_identifier)
          (identifier))))
    (declaration
      (primitive_type)
      (identifier))))

==========================================
__has_embed and __has_warning with strings
==========================================

#if __has_embed("data.bin")
int e;
#endif
#if __has_warning("-Wdeprecated")
int f;
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (preproc_if
    (call_expression
      (identifier)
      (argument_list
        (string_literal
          (string_content))))
    (declaration
      (primitive_type)
      (identifier)))
  (preproc_if
    (call_expression
      (identifier)
      (argument_list
        (string_literal
          (string_content))))
    (declaration
      (primitive_type)
      (identifier))))

==========================================
__has_include combined with defined
==========================================

#if defined(__has_include) && __has_include(<a.h>)
int g;
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (preproc_if
    (binary_expression
      (preproc_defined
        (identifier))
      (call_expression
        (identifier)
        (argument_list
          (system_lib_string))))
    (declaration
      (primitive_type)
      (identifier))))
